comment: M05 alpha gate and M05R review round: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242. Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D115); the monument shot is dropped (AR-15) for the rise cap's view. M07 adds a cabin and a radio tower and an oil rig; M12 adds the taper, lot, repair and feather views (docs/design/0010, 0011).
title: Alpha review: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets RWG2 terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: rise
shots.caption: Rise cap: the city street nearest the spawn beside RWG2 ground at least 12 blocks above it, from above the city looking at the slope. The city stops or steps down here instead of climbing it (AR-4).

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: a village's gate where the city's lane meets it, seen from beside the lane, the city on one side and the village on the other. The clearest gate within 48 chunks of the spawn, of the village by the pond that the reserved-lot and soft-edge shots show; 120 chunks out the clearest is a village in a forest of tall trees.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the margin the city leaves around a VillageNames village, from the south.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the city's margin, a chunk of natural ground the blend slopes from the city's edge to a village's ground, with the strip that meets the village's own edge and the lane's steps; the city builds inside it (AR-10, AR-11).

shots.name: scattered
shots.caption: Scattered structure: the cabin nearest the spawn, from the south-east and a little above. The ground under it is leveled and slopes back to RWG's terrain around it, with no cliff and nothing inside it (M07, design record 0009).

shots.name: tower
shots.caption: Scattered structure: the radio tower nearest the spawn, from the south-east and above: level ground under its legs, meeting RWG's terrain without a cliff (M07, 0009).

shots.name: oilrig
shots.caption: Oil rig: the one nearest the spawn, in RWG2's deep ocean (the oracle's floor at Y 45 or lower), from the south-east (M07, D31).

shots.name: taper
shots.caption: Tapering (AR-5): the city nearest the spawn from 48 blocks beyond its radius, low over the land; heights rise organically from low buildings and lots at the edge to the high-rise core.

shots.name: lot
shots.caption: Edge lot (AR-6): the nearest empty or construction lot at a city's edge, bare clay and dirt with nothing growing; excavations are dug 1, 2 or 4 blocks, foundations carry concrete columns.

shots.name: repair
shots.caption: Partial repair (AR-9): a building an explosion reached whose damage was partly filled back in with a similar but not identical material, its windows boarded.

shots.name: feather
shots.caption: Color feathering (AR-17): two neighboring buildings of different city styles; their facades stay within the contrast limit, no pale building beside a dark saturated one.
